spec.problem_statement: Enhance the existing URL shortener service to make shortened links easier to create, distribute, and share across channels while preserving backward compatibility with current shortening and redirect workflows.
functional_requirements: Allow users to provide an optional custom human-readable alias when shortening a URL, enforcing URL-safe character constraints and uniqueness.
Return the complete ready-to-share short URL (combining the configured base URL and short code) in link creation responses.
Provide an API endpoint that generates and serves a QR code (e.g., PNG or SVG) for an existing shortened link.
Expose a read endpoint or response payload providing link metadata (original URL, short code, full shareable URL) so users can inspect and re-share links.
Preserve existing automatic short code generation and HTTP redirect resolution behavior for all links.
non_functional_requirements: Maintain backward compatibility with existing service interfaces and test coverage in tests/test_shortener.py.
Validate and sanitize custom aliases and target URLs to prevent reserved-route collisions, injection, and unsafe redirects.
Return deterministic HTTP error responses (such as 400 for invalid input, 404 for missing links, and 409 for alias conflicts).
Ensure QR code generation and alias validation introduce minimal latency and align with the scalability guidance in docs/URL_SHORTENER_SCALABILITY.md.
Keep new dependencies minimal and explicitly declared in requirements.txt.
ambiguities_resolved: Interpreted 'make links easier to share' in the context of the existing URL shortener as supporting custom readable aliases, full copy-ready short URLs, and QR code generation rather than third-party social platform OAuth integrations.
Assumed full shareable URLs will be constructed using a configurable base URL setting or the incoming request host in app/main.py and app/service.py.
Assumed QR codes will be generated on demand from the short URL rather than stored as binary assets in app/storage.py.
Assumed custom aliases share the same namespace and collision checks as auto-generated short codes in app/storage.py.
Assumed no new user authentication or access-control layer is required beyond what the existing brownfield application already enforces.

impact.data_flow_summary: Incoming HTTP requests enter through FastAPI routes in app/main.py. POST /shorten validates ShortenRequest (url and optional custom_alias) and calls app/service.py create_short_url, which either persists the custom alias or retries up to 5 times with generate_code via app/storage.py save_url into the SQLite urls table, returning ShortenResponse with code, short_url, and original_url. GET /{code} calls resolve_short_url and get_url_and_increment to look up original_url, increment clicks, and issue a 307 RedirectResponse. GET /stats/{code} calls fetch_url_stats and get_stats to return stored metrics. Enhancements for easier creation, distribution, and cross-channel sharing extend these API, service, and SQLite storage layers while keeping existing endpoints and payload contracts intact.
integration_risks: The wildcard route GET /{code} in app/main.py can conflict with new top-level routes or allow custom_alias values that collide with reserved endpoints such as health, shorten, stats, or new share/distribution paths if route ordering and alias validation are not enforced.

Existing SQLite databases initialized with CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS urls in app/storage.py will not receive new columns unless explicit schema migration logic is added, risking runtime OperationalError on existing deployments.
Modifying ShortenRequest, ShortenResponse, or stats response schemas with non-optional fields or altered types would break backward compatibility for existing API clients and tests.
Appending channel tracking or UTM parameters during link creation or redirection could malform URLs that already contain query strings or fragments unless URL parsing is handled carefully.
Adding third-party libraries for distribution features such as QR code rendering or link previews introduces dependency, payload size, and error-handling risks into app/service.py and app/main.py.

Existing non-atomic select-then-update click tracking and per-operation SQLite connections in app/storage.py may face lock contention or race conditions if bulk creation or high-throughput channel sharing features are introduced.

tasks.title: Declare minimal QR code generation dependency
tasks.acceptance_criteria: requirements.txt explicitly pins a lightweight QR code generation library (such as segno or qrcode) without unnecessary transitive dependencies, and pip install succeeds cleanly.

tasks.title: Support custom alias uniqueness and metadata lookup in storage
tasks.acceptance_criteria: app/storage.py enforces uniqueness across both custom aliases and auto-generated codes, exposes deterministic conflict detection for duplicate aliases, supports non-incrementing metadata reads without altering existing click-tracking or schema compatibility for existing SQLite databases, and preserves all existing storage function signatures.

tasks.title: Implement alias validation, shareable URL formatting, metadata service, and QR generation
tasks.acceptance_criteria: app/service.py validates custom aliases against URL-safe character rules and reserved route names, validates target URLs against unsafe schemes, constructs complete shareable short URLs from a configurable base URL or fallback host, retrieves link metadata (original URL, short code, full shareable URL), generates on-demand QR codes (PNG or SVG) with minimal latency, and preserves existing auto-code generation and redirect resolution behavior.

tasks.title: Expose custom alias, shareable URL, metadata, and QR code API endpoints
tasks.acceptance_criteria: app/main.py accepts optional custom_alias in POST /shorten and returns the full shareable short_url while preserving backward-compatible fields, adds endpoints to serve QR codes and link metadata before the wildcard GET /{code} route to prevent route collisions, returns deterministic HTTP status codes (400 for invalid input/alias, 404 for missing links, 409 for alias conflicts), and preserves existing redirect and stats endpoints.

tasks.title: Verify sharing enhancements and backward compatibility in test suite
tasks.acceptance_criteria: tests/test_shortener.py retains all existing tests passing and adds coverage for valid/invalid custom aliases, reserved-route and duplicate alias conflicts (400/409), complete shareable short_url construction, metadata retrieval, QR code generation (200 and 404), and unchanged redirect behavior.

import importlib.util
import sys
import types
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app import main, service, storage
from app.main import app

_MINIMAL_PNG = (
    b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
    b"\x00\x00\x00\rIHDR\x00\x00\x00\x01\x00\x00\x00\x01\x08\x02\x00\x00\x00\x90wS\xde"
    b"\x00\x00\x00\x0cIDATx\x9cc```\x00\x00\x00\x04\x00\x01\xf6\x178U"
    b"\x00\x00\x00\x00IEND\xaeB`\x82"
)


@pytest.fixture()
def client(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch):
    db_file = tmp_path / "test_urls.db"
    for env_var in ("SHORTENER_DB_PATH", "DB_PATH", "DATABASE_PATH", "SQLITE_DB_PATH"):
        monkeypatch.setenv(env_var, str(db_file))
    for env_var in ("SHORTENER_BASE_URL", "BASE_URL", "APP_BASE_URL", "PUBLIC_BASE_URL"):
        monkeypatch.delenv(env_var, raising=False)
    for attr in ("DB_PATH", "DATABASE_PATH", "DEFAULT_DB_PATH", "SQLITE_DB_PATH"):
        if hasattr(storage, attr):
            current = getattr(storage, attr)
            monkeypatch.setattr(storage, attr, db_file if isinstance(current, Path) else str(db_file))
    if hasattr(storage, "init_db"):
        storage.init_db()
    with TestClient(app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


@pytest.fixture()
def ensure_qr_backend(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    if (
        importlib.util.find_spec("segno") is not None
        or importlib.util.find_spec("qrcode") is not None
    ):
        return

    class _FakeQR:
        def __init__(self, data: str) -> None:
            self._data = data

        def save(self, buf, kind: str = "png", **_kwargs) -> None:
            if kind == "svg":
                svg = (
                    '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 21 21">'
                    f"<desc>{self._data}</desc>"
                    '<rect width="21" height="21" fill="#000"/></svg>'
                ).encode("utf-8")
                buf.write(svg)
            else:
                buf.write(_MINIMAL_PNG)

    fake_segno = types.ModuleType("segno")
    fake_segno.make = lambda data, error="m": _FakeQR(data)
    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, "segno", fake_segno)


def test_health_endpoint(client: TestClient):
    res = client.get("/health")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json() == {"status": "ok"}


def test_shorten_redirect_and_stats_backward_compatibility(client: TestClient):
    target_url = "https://example.com/docs?ref=home#top"
    create_res = client.post("/shorten", json={"url": target_url})
    assert create_res.status_code == 201

    payload = create_res.json()
    code = payload["code"]
    assert len(code) >= 3
    assert payload["original_url"] == target_url
    assert payload["short_url"] == f"http://testserver/{code}"

    stats_before = client.get(f"/stats/{code}")
    assert stats_before.status_code == 200
    assert stats_before.json()["code"] == code
    assert stats_before.json()["original_url"] == target_url
    assert stats_before.json()["clicks"] == 0

    redirect_res = client.get(f"/{code}", follow_redirects=False)
    assert redirect_res.status_code == 307
    assert redirect_res.headers["location"] == target_url

    stats_after = client.get(f"/stats/{code}")
    assert stats_after.status_code == 200
    assert stats_after.json()["clicks"] == 1


def test_missing_code_returns_404(client: TestClient):
    assert client.get("/doesnotexist").status_code == 404
    assert client.get("/stats/doesnotexist").status_code == 404
    assert client.get("/metadata/doesnotexist").status_code == 404
    assert client.get("/qr/doesnotexist").status_code == 404


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "bad_url",
    [
        "",
        "   ",
        "not-a-url",
        "ftp://example.com/file",
        "javascript:alert(1)",
        "https://",
        "https://example.com/bad\npath",
    ],
)
def test_invalid_target_url_returns_400(client: TestClient, bad_url: str):
    res = client.post("/shorten", json={"url": bad_url})
    assert res.status_code == 400


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "alias",
    [
        "abc",
        "launch-2025",
        "Team_Docs_1",
        "a" * 20,
    ],
)
def test_valid_custom_alias_creation_and_redirect(client: TestClient, alias: str):
    target_url = "https://example.com/product"
    create_res = client.post(
        "/shorten",
        json={"url": target_url, "custom_alias": alias},
    )
    assert create_res.status_code == 201

    body = create_res.json()
    assert body["code"] == alias
    assert body["original_url"] == target_url
    assert body["short_url"] == f"http://testserver/{alias}"

    redirect_res = client.get(f"/{alias}", follow_redirects=False)
    assert redirect_res.status_code == 307
    assert redirect_res.headers["location"] == target_url


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "bad_alias",
    [
        "",
        "ab",
        "a" * 21,
        "bad alias",
        "bad/alias",
        "bad?alias",
        "bad.alias",
        "emoji!@#",
    ],
)
def test_invalid_custom_alias_returns_400(client: TestClient, bad_alias: str):
    res = client.post(
        "/shorten",
        json={"url": "https://example.com", "custom_alias": bad_alias},
    )
    assert res.status_code == 400


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "reserved_alias",
    [
        "health",
        "HEALTH",
        "shorten",
        "stats",
        "Stats",
        "qr",
        "metadata",
        "docs",
        "openapi.json",
    ],
)
def test_reserved_route_alias_returns_400(client: TestClient, reserved_alias: str):
    res = client.post(
        "/shorten",
        json={"url": "https://example.com", "custom_alias": reserved_alias},
    )
    assert res.status_code == 400


def test_duplicate_custom_alias_returns_409(client: TestClient):
    first = client.post(
        "/shorten",
        json={"url": "https://example.com/one", "custom_alias": "promo-2025"},
    )
    assert first.status_code == 201

    duplicate = client.post(
        "/shorten",
        json={"url": "https://example.com/two", "custom_alias": "promo-2025"},
    )
    assert duplicate.status_code == 409

    redirect_res = client.get("/promo-2025", follow_redirects=False)
    assert redirect_res.status_code == 307
    assert redirect_res.headers["location"] == "https://example.com/one"


def test_custom_alias_conflicts_with_existing_auto_generated_code(client: TestClient):
    auto_res = client.post("/shorten", json={"url": "https://example.com/auto"})
    assert auto_res.status_code == 201
    generated_code = auto_res.json()["code"]

    conflict_res = client.post(
        "/shorten",
        json={"url": "https://example.com/override", "custom_alias": generated_code},
    )
    assert conflict_res.status_code == 409


def test_configured_base_url_for_shareable_links(
    client: TestClient, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
):
    for env_var in ("SHORTENER_BASE_URL", "BASE_URL", "APP_BASE_URL", "PUBLIC_BASE_URL"):
        monkeypatch.setenv(env_var, "https://sho.rt")
    for module in (main, service):
        for attr in ("BASE_URL", "SHORTENER_BASE_URL"):
            if hasattr(module, attr):
                monkeypatch.setattr(module, attr, "https://sho.rt")

    create_res = client.post(
        "/shorten",
        json={"url": "https://example.com/share", "custom_alias": "share-me"},
    )
    assert create_res.status_code == 201
    assert create_res.json()["short_url"] == "https://sho.rt/share-me"

    meta_res = client.get("/metadata/share-me")
    assert meta_res.status_code == 200
    assert meta_res.json()["short_url"] == "https://sho.rt/share-me"


def test_metadata_retrieval_does_not_increment_clicks(client: TestClient):
    create_res = client.post(
        "/shorten",
        json={"url": "https://example.com/guide", "custom_alias": "inspect-me"},
    )
    assert create_res.status_code == 201

    meta_res = client.get("/metadata/inspect-me")
    assert meta_res.status_code == 200
    meta_payload = meta_res.json()
    assert meta_payload["code"] == "inspect-me"
    assert meta_payload["original_url"] == "https://example.com/guide"
    assert meta_payload["short_url"] == "http://testserver/inspect-me"

    stats_before = client.get("/stats/inspect-me")
    assert stats_before.status_code == 200
    assert stats_before.json()["clicks"] == 0

    redirect_res = client.get("/inspect-me", follow_redirects=False)
    assert redirect_res.status_code == 307

    stats_after = client.get("/stats/inspect-me")
    assert stats_after.status_code == 200
    assert stats_after.json()["clicks"] == 1


def test_qr_code_generation_png_and_svg(
    client: TestClient, ensure_qr_backend: None
):
    create_res = client.post(
        "/shorten",
        json={"url": "https://example.com/event", "custom_alias": "event-2025"},
    )
    assert create_res.status_code == 201

    png_res = client.get("/qr/event-2025")
    assert png_res.status_code == 200
    assert png_res.headers["content-type"].startswith("image/png")
    assert png_res.content.startswith(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n")

    svg_res = client.get("/qr/event-2025?format=svg")
    assert svg_res.status_code == 200
    assert svg_res.headers["content-type"].startswith("image/svg+xml")
    assert b"<svg" in svg_res.content


def test_qr_code_invalid_format_returns_400(client: TestClient):
    create_res = client.post(
        "/shorten",
        json={"url": "https://example.com/qr", "custom_alias": "qr-bad-fmt"},
    )
    assert create_res.status_code == 201

    bad_res = client.get("/qr/qr-bad-fmt?format=bmp")
    assert bad_res.status_code == 400

technical_risks: Race conditions in the shared short-code namespace during concurrent custom alias creation or auto-generation if storage lacks atomic check-and-set semantics.
Per-request CPU and memory overhead from on-demand QR code PNG and SVG generation without caching or rate limiting, which may impact tail latency under load.
Potential Host header spoofing or mismatched scheme/domain in generated shareable URLs and QR payloads when falling back to incoming request host values.
Reserved-route list drift if new endpoints are added later without updating alias validation rules.
Review scope is limited to specification metadata and tool logs, so actual implementation details in app/main.py, app/service.py, app/storage.py, and requirements.txt were not directly inspected.
tradeoffs_made: Generating QR codes on demand rather than persisting binary assets keeps storage simple and stateless at the cost of higher per-request compute.
Sharing a single flat namespace between custom aliases and auto-generated short codes preserves short URL ergonomics while requiring strict reserved-route filtering and collision handling.
Supporting a configurable base URL with request-host fallback improves deployment flexibility over strict static configuration, at the risk of proxy host mismatches.
Scoping sharing enhancements to custom aliases, canonical URLs, metadata, and QR endpoints without adding authentication or OAuth preserves backward compatibility and minimal dependencies.
failure_scenarios: Two concurrent requests registering the same custom alias simultaneously could bypass non-atomic uniqueness checks and overwrite a link or trigger an unhandled server error instead of HTTP 409.
Traffic spikes targeting the QR endpoint for viral links could degrade API responsiveness due to repeated on-demand image rendering.
Incorrect reverse-proxy forwarding or an unset base URL could cause shareable links and QR codes to embed internal hostnames or incorrect schemes.
Requesting QR codes or metadata for deleted or nonexistent codes, or specifying unsupported QR formats, must consistently yield deterministic 404 or 400 responses rather than unhandled exceptions.
